content: Team-apparel ordering platforms (Exclaim, Wooter, TeamSeams, Spectrum) treat the roster (player name, number, size) as a first-class order artifact, reusable across reorders, replacing error-prone spreadsheet/chat roster management. No authoritative PH-specific source found for downpayment norms; CSPS UI spec copy itself states mockup -> downpayment -> production -> settle balance.
